theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_smp_strip_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (W S : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ c) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → x ∈ S) → tsupport η ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (η x) ≤ 1) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm (η x)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * μ (W ∩ S)
